defects.defect: Odds table panel is cut off by the bottom nav bar — only the header row and the 'Common' row are visible, the panel's bottom frame and remaining rarity rows are clipped
defects.direction: Add bottom scroll padding / reduce panel heights so the full framed odds table clears the tab bar
defects.region: Pull odds panel, bottom of screen (y≈1215-1345)

defects.defect: Body copy 'Better odds pull rarer gear...' floats directly on the portal artwork with no plate or scrim, colliding with scene detail (torches/crystals) and hurting legibility
defects.direction: Move the caption below the art onto a wood plate, or add a dark scrim strip behind it
defects.region: Portal panel, description text over scene (y≈700-760)

defects.defect: The bottom navigation overlaps and hides most of the pull-odds panel, leaving only its header and first row partially visible.
defects.direction: Reserve bottom safe-area space or make the content scroll above the navigation so the full odds table is visible.

defects.defect: Odds table is cut off mid-row by the tab bar; the Common row's progress bar and any following rarity rows are clipped and the panel's bottom frame is hidden
defects.direction: Shorten or reposition the odds panel (or add bottom scroll inset) so full rows and the panel's framed bottom edge clear the tab bar

defects.defect: Summon CTA is overlaid on top of the framed art panel and overlaps the panel's inner frame edge instead of sitting in its own row
defects.direction: Pull the button out below the art frame (or inset it fully with even padding) so no frame overlap occurs

defects.defect: The current-odds column (60%) has no header and does not align under 'Pull odds' or 'Next tier', making the two percentage columns ambiguous
defects.direction: Add a 'Current' column header aligned over the 60% column and right-align both percentage columns consistently

defects.defect: Odds columns lack alignment structure — the 60%/45% values are right-of-center with no column headers directly above them ('Next tier' header sits far right of its value column)
defects.direction: Right-align numeric columns to fixed column x-positions and align each header to its column

defects.defect: The visible odds panel is crowded directly against the fixed navigation, making the lower screen feel clipped rather than intentionally spaced.
defects.direction: Add a clear bottom inset below the odds panel or adjust the viewport scroll position.

defects.defect: The caption text 'Rarer gear clears deeper levels' overlaps the torch/brazier props in the scene, reducing legibility against busy art
defects.direction: Add a subtle dark scrim behind the caption or nudge it above the props so it sits on quieter background

defects.defect: Tier badge baseline sits slightly high relative to the large title's optical center
defects.direction: Vertically center the badge to the title's cap-height midpoint

defects.defect: The Mages character icon is substantially smaller and less visually prominent than the Home, Rift, and Settings icons.
defects.direction: Increase the Mages icon’s rendered size and visual weight to match its sibling tabs.
